description: Browse the RAREEAI marketplace: kind="providers" (listings, filterable and sorted) or "oracles". Paged.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return. Up to 200. Default 50.

offset.description: Rows to skip, for paging. Default 0.

oracle_verified.description: Only providers that opted in to oracle verification (true) or did not (false).

resource_type.description: Listings of this resource type only (providers).

sort.description: Sort order, e.g. price_asc (default) or price_desc.

name: market_listings
